study: Historical referee-specific Crown AH market-residual test; referees from retrospective archive, target assignment first-known time unavailable.

methodology.identity: Reuse the audited R49 team/competition bridge from m8_prior_manager_turnover_20261117.py. Target TM fixture requires same competition, mapped home/away club IDs, FT, and date within +/-1 day; ambiguous matches are excluded. Referee names are normalized exact strings, no fuzzy referee matching.
methodology.feature: For each referee and competition, trailing 365-day mean of earlier Crown AH actual goal-difference minus Crown-implied home margin; subtract trailing same-competition residual mean and shrink by n/(n+5). Use only matches ending at least 3 Beijing calendar days before target. Same-day features snapshot before any same-day updates.
methodology.target: Target outcome is home goal difference. Crown-implied home margin = -AH_home_line + 0.25*ln(away_odds/home_odds).
methodology.models: Expanding years: train 2019 through year-before; fixed Ridge alpha 100 after training-fold feature standardization; market-only [market margin, line, water adjustment], market+ref adds shrunken referee residual and log prior-ref sample count; ref-only diagnostic.
methodology.AH_EV: Predicted goal-margin normal distribution discretized to integer margins -12..12 with training residual RMSE as sigma; choose side with larger expected Crown AH settlement. Also report no-bet diagnostic when both predicted sides EV<=0; it is experimental evaluation only.
methodology.leakage: No target score enters its features/model. Referee histories update only after the full Beijing date. The target referee name is drawn from the retrospective game archive and has no verified pregame announcement/receipt timestamp; this is not a verified contemporaneous prediction.
